leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a controlled input component by binding its value to React state
Construct an uncontrolled input component using the useRef hook
Manipulate form data by updating state in response to input changes
Initialize form values by setting default state for controlled inputs
Integrate form submission logic that accesses both controlled and uncontrolled values
Render a form that demonstrates the behavioral differences between controlled and uncontrolled inputs
Configure a form with mixed controlled and uncontrolled input strategies
